summary: London-Corbin Airport/Magee Field is a publicly owned, general aviation airport serving the London-Corbin metropolitan area in southeastern Kentucky. Located in Laurel County, it supports corporate, recreational, and emergency aviation activity for the region. The facility also hosts the National Guard armory and has historically been used for flight training operations.
faqs:
Q: How far is London-Corbin Airport from downtown London, KY?
A: The airport is approximately 3 miles south of downtown London, making it a quick 10-minute drive via US-25 and KY-2296.

Q: Does LOZ offer commercial airline service?
A: No, London-Corbin Airport is primarily a general aviation facility and does not currently have scheduled commercial passenger flights.

Q: Is there an FBO (Fixed Base Operator) at the airport?
A: Yes, the airport has FBO services offering fuel, hangar space, and aircraft maintenance for transient and based pilots.

Q: What is the runway length at Magee Field?
A: The airport features a single asphalt runway (Runway 5/23) measuring approximately 5,751 feet in length.
transport_tips: Rental cars are the most convenient option for ground transportation, as the airport does not have a dedicated shuttle service or rideshare staging area. Taxis and pre-arranged limousine services from local providers can be called upon arrival. The airport's location near the junction of I-75 and US-25 makes it a convenient gateway for travelers heading to Cumberland Falls or Corbin.
local_tip: If you're flying in for the annual World Chicken Festival in London, book your hangar space well in advance—the airport sees a noticeable uptick in traffic during the festival weekend each September.
